description: Owner «Да» 2026-11-28 13:44Z (event cff080ab-fc51-4e90-8f7c-9e888bc7211c): in the Korea Search campaign every responsive search ad gets «Авто з Кореї під ключ Київ» / «Купити авто з Кореї» (uk) and «Авто из Кореи под ключ Киев» / «Купить авто из Кореи» (ru) in place of «Передоплата в ціні авто» / «Етап доставки онлайн» (uk) and «Предоплата в цене авто» / «Этап доставки онлайн» (ru); a new headline already in the ad only drops the old one. Bounded run in the existing private inbox: upload this package, run source_remote.py once in a temporary always-on task (removed after its receipt; never the CRM bot) which reads the ENABLED/PAUSED responsive search ads and sends one googleAds:mutate (partialFailure) with one AdOperation update (mask responsive_search_ad.headlines) per ad that has an old headline (about 70 operations); per ad before, after and refusals with policy topics in the report. Budget, bids, keywords and every other setting unchanged (checked before/after). No site, CRM or bot change.
title: Google Ads Korea ad headlines
